title: Interstellar
overview: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to save humanity from extinction. Explores deep space, wormholes, black holes, time dilation, and the bond between a father and his daughter.

title: Inception
overview: A skilled thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO inside nested dream levels.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: When the psychological menace known as the Joker emerges, Batman must confront chaos, moral dilemma, vigilante justice, and corruption in Gotham City.

title: Spirited Away
overview: A ten-year-old girl wanders into a magical world ruled by spirits, witches, and gods, where her parents are transformed into beasts and she must work at a bathhouse to free them.

title: Whiplash
overview: A promising young jazz drummer enrolls at a cutthroat music conservatory where his pursuit of perfection is pushed to extreme limits by an abusive instructor.

title: La La Land
overview: While navigating their careers in Los Angeles, a struggling jazz pianist and an aspiring actress fall in love while chasing their Hollywood dreams.
